description: Deterministic current-account Wu Ming solo coverage. WIP attacks with Wu Ming 3/3/3 and 170 each T6 Infantry, Lancers, and Marksmen into minxxx's 380 each T6 Infantry and Lancers. Using current no-hero stats, Wu Ming's S6 contribution estimated from the recent WIP Renee report, and the published skill values: the configured interpretation predicts a signed remaining score near -7; omitting S1's normal-damage reduction predicts about -297; omitting S2 predicts about -306; and incorrectly allowing S3 to amplify normal attacks predicts about +344. The exact captured stats will be substituted into these frozen interpretations after capture. This fixture positively exercises S1's normal-damage branch and S2; it checks that S3 remains inert without skill-damage jobs, but cannot positively validate S1's skill-damage branch or S3's amplification.
